name: playradar
description: PlayRadar — video game price comparison (React + Express). Projet Web, Objectif 4.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run demo -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
